widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the female warrior defined by the provided three-view character reference: a young woman with long black hair partly swept into a high bun crowned by an ornate silver hairpiece set with a blue gem, silver phoenix-style hairpins with dangling pearl tassels, a small red floral mark on the forehead, pearl drop earrings, layered guofeng attire consisting of a pale blue-white wide-sleeved outer robe with silver embroidery, a deep blue inner robe and skirt with a white center panel, an ornate silver belt with hanging tassels, silver forearm guards, dark blue ribbons trailing from the hair, and dark cloth boots.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 15-second vertical 9:16 live-action cinematic one-take parkour sequence in bright white daylight, in which <Subject 1> sprints through an ancient alley, vaults a bamboo pole, wall-kicks onto an awning and tile eaves, and leaps onto the main roof ridge, while the camera always faces forward along her running route, changing viewpoint only through pedestal, tilt, truck, Dutch angle and zoom, never pulling back, orbiting or panning backward.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved

detailed_description:
Vertical 9:16 live-action wuxia film style, single continuous one-take, bright white daylight with clean high-key exposure over weathered gray-brick alleys and dark tiled rooftops. [Shot 1] The one-take opens with a low-angle Tracking Shot from behind at 0.4 meters above the ground, following <Subject 1> as she sprints forward through the alley mouth, camera behind her and slightly left; ahead a horizontal bamboo laundry pole about one meter high blocks the path with cloth curtains hanging nearby. She plants her left foot on the right wall and launches, body flipping sideways over the pole, her displaced air flapping the curtains; as she jumps the camera abruptly Tilts Up and Pushes In with a Zoom In, then after clearing the pole quickly Tilts Down back to the low angle while Trucking Left half a step, settling behind her slightly right as she lands and keeps sprinting. From 00:03.000 she kicks the walls left, right, left in sequence, leaps, grabs the second-floor eave beam with both hands, swings up onto the rain-shelter awning, runs two steps crouched and steps onto the tile eave; the camera rapidly Pedestals Down to ground level simulating a low sprint, abruptly Pedestals Up to waist height, strongly Pushes In and Tilts Up almost against her back as she grabs the beam, then Rolls Clockwise about 15 degrees into a brief Dutch angle simulating imbalance and quickly levels, holding directly behind her. From 00:06.000 she sprints along the tile eave, sidles her body, kicks a corner stone water vat, leaps upward and hooks the higher roof-eave edge; the camera rapidly Pedestals Down to tile height parallel to her crouched body, slides past, sharply Tilts Up and surges forward, Zooms In to a medium shot at the vat kick while Trucking Left to avoid a hanging lantern, then Tilts Up beyond 60 degrees elevation filming her gripping the eave, view always facing forward-up, never turning back. From 00:09.000 she vaults onto the eave, a tile loosens underfoot, she flows into a half roll on her back to absorb the force, rises and runs diagonally along the ridge, left high right low; the camera rapidly Pedestals Up to her height, rolls into a second brief Dutch angle while Pushing In to convey sliding instability, Pedestals Down close to the tile surface and Trucks Left during her roll, then Tilts Up and levels, tracking her diagonal ridge run from about two meters behind her slightly right. From 00:12.000 she reaches the ridge end, leaps with full force, arms spread, glides past a small pavilion's window lattice and lands on the main house's main ridge; at takeoff the camera sharply Pedestals Down and Pushes In into a large low angle against the sky, quickly Tilts Up and Zooms Out following her flight arc, abruptly stops with a slight upward tilt at landing; she stands firm and slowly turns to look back, the only head turn while the camera never turns, and the camera keeps facing forward, Pushing In to a close-up of her stunning smiling face turned toward the path she came, background the distant white sky, holding 0.5 seconds before ending. Throughout, viewpoint changes use only pedestal, tilt, truck, roll and zoom while traveling forward; no pull-back, no backward movement, no orbit, no backward pan.

overall_soundscape:
Rapid footsteps on stone and tile, robe and sleeve cloth fluttering, the whoosh of her body crossing the bamboo pole with flapping curtains, wall-kick thuds, a wooden beam grab creak, loose tiles sliding and cracking underfoot and on landing, a soft scuff during her roll, and light rooftop wind; no speech.

non_diegetic_music:
A driving wuxia orchestral score with fast taiko pulses, pounding drums and surging strings, a soaring dizi and erhu theme that swells at the final leap and settles into one sustained elegant held note during the closing freeze.
